contract.title: Incident Response Dashboard Visual Unification REWORK 1
acceptance_criteria: Only the page-local IncidentResponseOverviewPage CSS and focused test may change; IncidentResponseOverviewPage TSX, product data logic and all protected files remain unchanged.
The immutable visual authority remains .ai/references/TASK-0125-product-owner-mockup.png with SHA-256 13b0739e46aecebef1b4013ac86f8ae11a86b1d214be2a67f2946fdd08177435 and dimensions 1402 x 1122.

At a 1402px viewport the frozen 164px Sidebar leaves a 1238px Main track and page-local arithmetic produces the reference-aligned usable Incident Overview width without shell changes, negative margins, transforms or offset compensation.
The middle row resolves within six pixels of 613px Active Incidents and 596px Response Status with a 14px gap and 373px height without overflow or clipping.
The bottom row resolves within six pixels of 613px Response Playbooks and 596px Recent Activity with a 14px gap and 325px height without overflow or clipping.
The snapshot grid deterministically resolves its five ordered cards within six pixels of 231 234 225 228 and 223px with 131px height and 13 to 14px gaps.

Snapshot arithmetic defines the grid inner width, subtracts four gaps, sums all fractional tracks, calculates each card independently and proves total tracks plus gaps fit without overflow or clipping.
Negative geometry fixtures reject an incorrect inner width, incorrect fractional ratios, an equal five-column substitute that violates target widths and an overflow configuration.
Geometry tests explicitly document controlled deterministic CSS arithmetic and do not claim native browser pixel measurement; Product Owner browser acceptance remains mandatory.
Response Status uses recognizable symmetric circular or ring-shaped unavailable geometry consistent with the visual authority and visibly states Unavailable.
Response Status contains no unequal bars, varying data segments, percentage, numerical measurement, point series, trend line, direction or implied status distribution.
Truthfulness regression tests inspect productive structure and CSS and reject the prior 38 67 and 51px bar series plus unequal bar, variable segment, percentage, point and trend-path fixtures.

The existing single getIncidents flow, real active count, exact open and investigating filtering, loading error empty no-active and real-active states and encoded Command Center links remain unchanged and passing.

The overview performs no Command Center bulk request and does not add synthetic incidents, severity, criticality, MTTR, containment, task, status, playbook, activity, trend, percentage or time-series data.
Critical Incidents, MTTR and Contained Incidents remain Unavailable; Open Tasks and Response Playbooks remain Not connected; Recent Activity remains Unavailable without values or illustrative rows.

Incident Queue, Command Center, all Incident routes, Back and Forward behavior, URL authority, Sidebar, Topbar, WorkspaceSwitcher, Platform shell, TASK-0122 through TASK-0124, backend, providers and references remain unchanged.

Focused geometry and truthfulness tests, Incident state and routing regressions, Queue and Command Center regressions, shell and cross-workspace regressions and TASK-0122 through TASK-0124 regressions pass.
Full frontend regression, TypeScript, production build and git diff --check pass; Scope Guard reports exactly the two authorized files and protected reference hashes remain unchanged.
Architect Implementation Review directly verifies page arithmetic, snapshot arithmetic, middle and bottom geometry and neutral Response Status semantics before Product Owner Live Acceptance.
Do not transition TASK-0125 to DONE or create TASK-0126.
